    if len(data) < 2:
        return

    n, m = data[0], data[1]
    adj = [[] for _ in range(n + 1)]

        u, v = data[idx], data[idx + 1]
        idx += 2
        adj[u].append(v)
        adj[v].append(u)

    dist = [-1] * (n + 1)
    q = deque([1])
    dist[1] = 0

    ans = 0

    while q:
        curr = q.popleft()

        for nxt in adj[curr]:
            if dist[nxt] == -1:
                dist[nxt] = dist[curr] + 1
                q.append(nxt)
                if dist[nxt] <= 2:
                    ans += 1

    print(ans)
